rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, seminars, workshops and distance learning approved by an industry-recognized local, state, national or international organization or accredited institution of higher learning (e.g. WAMFT, WSSCSW, NASW and WA chapter, AMHCA, AAMFT, CSWA, NBCC, WMHCA, SSWLHC); distance learning must include a comprehension test. Employer-sponsored training max 26 hours; panels, community service, research, peer consultation, publishing max 6 hours per period; presenters get attendee credit.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First suicide training is due in the first full CE period after initial licensure; it may be delayed six years if equivalent training was completed within six years before licensure.
rules.audit_note: Documentation (transcripts, certificates, instructor letters) kept as required in chapter 246-12 WAC (WAC 246-809-650).

topics.who: All licensees; may include topics under RCW 18.130.180
All licensees: professional roles and boundaries, separate from the ethics hours
All licensees, at least every four years (content per WAC 246-12-830)

All licensees: suicide assessment, treatment and management from the DOH model list, at least once every six years; first training in the first full CE period after licensure; second must be advanced/treatment-modality training. Counts toward the 32 hours.

rules.notes: License renews every year on the birthday (WAC 246-809-990); CE is reported per two-year period. Associates (separate credential) need 16 hours every year. Social worker associates advanced/independent clinical also need 6 hours of suicide training before the first renewal.
